pcs.pc_description: follow routine of child’s daily chores namely, eating, toilet habit, resting and recreation as decided by the parent/guardian
Ensure that the child does not use the electronic gadgets beyond the schedule given by the parents/ guardians
perform housekeeping duties such as cleaning, laundry, dish washing and bed making for the child
pick and drop off the child from play centers/ kindergarten timely and safely
choose appropriate clothes for the child/ ensure that the child is appropriately dressed
prepare play area/ child’s room as per the child’s age and directions of parents/ guardians

modules.module_title: Fulfill and take care of child’s physical and nutritional needs

pcs.pc_description: bathe and dress the child
maintain hygiene and grooming like taking care for hair, skin, nails/ toes, eyes and teeth according to procedures
identify and engage with parents/guardian for any specific requirements and feeding routines
prepare and store food and drink for the child hygienically and according to any specific instructions
recognize signs of illness in the child and respond/inform parents/ guardians accordingly

modules.module_title: Carry out child focused indoor/ outdoor activities

pcs.pc_description: arrange and set up the surroundings with books, toys, games, etc. as guided by parents/ guardians
Conduct games and activities, which will have positive impact of the growth of child
observe and monitor child’s movement with a view to their potential and safety
discern how the children communicate, express their feelings and respond to a situation
observe how the child interacts with others and plays with other children

modules.module_title: Enable children to participate in playful activities to encourage learning and development

pcs.pc_description: identify individual or group play activities, with the view to support growth and development of the child
ensure that the child behaves in a friendly manner while playing with others
ensure that the child is pro-social and respectful of others
model gender neutral behavior
encourage the active participation in creative and other learning activities that meet the child’s preferences and needs
ensure that the play environment is hygienic, safe and secure

modules.module_title: Understand and respond to the child’s preferences and needs

pcs.pc_description: respond to the child by appreciating using positive approach and attitude
respond appropriately in situations where the child is distressed, anxious or parting from parents/ guardians
give regular reports and updates to parents/ guardian about the child

modules.module_title: Establish a healthy, safe and secure environment for the child

pcs.pc_description: work with the parents/ guardians to make the play/ learning area secure and safe both indoors and outdoors.
assess the health, safety and security of the work place before starting, during and at the end of work activities
check all areas of work place for safety and health hazards and remove them
remove the risk of injury from falling, slipping and tripping, electrical shocks for the children.
keep the chemicals and drugs which may be poisonous from the reach of the children
warn all children and adults using the work place about the hazards present therein
periodically review, revise and follow hygiene, health, safety and security procedures
maintain continuous watch on the child, if necessary, using appropriate technology
brief and supervise the child about what is inappropriate touch, bullying, and actions thereof to avoid these negative influences
identify any signs of abuse and harassment, accident, injury, pain, and other symptoms illness and address the same under guidance from the parents/ guardian
protect and make the child aware of the threats from interaction with undesirable persons to avoid possible harassment, abuse and abduction

modules.module_title: Assist in procedures with respect to accidents, injuries,illnesses and other emergencies

pcs.pc_description: make sure that accidents, injuries, signs of illness and other emergencies are promptly identified
follow the correct procedures to deal with accidents, injuries, signs of illness and other emergencies calmly and safely including reporting to right persons
maintain record of relevant helplines and immediate family, neighbour’s contact details
maintain first aid kit as per as required and ensure that the contents are replaced prior to the expiry
